FM_CH1.notes: Five short C3/G2/F2/G2/C3 bass accents; no continuous low bed.

FM_CH2.notes: V012-positive contour C5-G5-E5-F5 | D5-G5-B5-C6, rearticulated with short 6/8 attacks and two intentional phrase breaths.

FM_CH3.notes: Four independent chord tones E4/A4/D4/E4; short lower support, no sustained harmonic bed.

FM_CH4.notes: Quiet additive FM7 crystal voice: 5-frame C6/E6/G6 flashes at score frames 0/30/105; rests through all PCM windows.

FM_CH5.notes: Livre; fallback para reduzir densidade do arranjo.

PSG_CH1.notes: No PSG glints in V015; retain only named event fallbacks.

PSG_CH2.notes: No PSG final fifth in V015; retain only named event fallbacks.

PSG_CH3.notes: Fallback nomeado para cues quando PCM nao estiver disponivel.

PSG_NOISE.notes: Fizz curto sincronizado; nunca uma cama continua.

dac_budget.clipping_policy: Unsigned 8-bit source centred at 128; reject 0x00/0xFF clipping and audit the signed XGM2 payload after conversion.

fm_patch_palette.timbre_goal: precise electronic pulse with a short, controlled low end
fm_patch_palette.patch_notes: Algorithm 4 paired output paths; very short C/G/F/G/C root accents and controlled release.

fm_patch_palette.timbre_goal: bright FM brass-like melody with fast attack and a clear upper-mid register
fm_patch_palette.patch_notes: Algorithm 5 with three audible carriers, modest feedback, quick attack and short note gates; V012 contour retained with deliberate rests.

fm_patch_palette.timbre_goal: soft digital bell tone carrying chord notes below the brass lead
fm_patch_palette.patch_notes: Algorithm 7 with a stepped harmonic spectrum, quick onset and four short chord-tone responses.

fm_patch_palette.timbre_goal: thin, bright upper sparkle with a fast attack and short decay
fm_patch_palette.patch_notes: Algorithm 7 additive partials with restrained detune; only five-frame C6/E6/G6 sparks, never a sustained line.

psg_usage.role: Silent in the V015 arrangement; PSG is reserved for named fallbacks if PCM cannot start.
psg_usage.noise_use: Reserve noise for a short cue fallback; no continuous noise bed.
psg_usage.fallback: Use a short named PSG contour only if PCM is unavailable; no musical PSG glints in V015.

dac_pcm_usage.purpose: Four short energy, lock, sweep, and tail textures; no PCM music bed.
dac_pcm_usage.sample_budget_policy: 13.3 kHz mono; cues use PCM CH2/CH3, at most two simultaneously; convert WAV sources with sample_convert.py and preserve lineage.

sound_chip_identity_plan.reference_translation_policy: Translate the blue digital reveal and the user's general 16-bit sonic-logo qualities into an original C-major YM2612/PSG phrase with short DAC punctuation; no copied melody, logo, recording, sample bed, or native SNES echo.

fallback_plan: If a PCM cue cannot start, play its named short PSG contour at reduced priority. If the music is not playing, do not restart any legacy FORJA V2 track.
